title: Ethan Chen
text:
About me
I was born in Taiwan and I moved to Vancouver when I was 10 years old. I did my highschool in Vancouver and I went to University of Waterloo for my undergraduate degree in software engineering. I have mostly worked as a full-stack development intern in multiple companies. By joining MDSCL, I hope to gain relevant technical skills, make valuable connections, and advance my career.

title: My first weeks in MDS
text:
Dinner with from friends on campus after imagine day.


Orientation days were nerve-wracking, sitting long hours, trying to absorb all the information, and meeting professors and classmates for the first time. However, I ended up meeting a lot of new friends, many that come from similar and also different backgrounds.
First week of school was not too bad. It was a scramble to get to the classrooms and figure out breaks to eat, but in general it went pretty smoothly.
I am feeling ok, a little anxious for the workload and quizzes that are about to come, but also excited to enjoy campus life and work on some fun projects.

Why Data Science
I did mostly full-stack web development for my co-ops during undergrad, and I wanted to pivot into more data analysis jobs. I am also interested in learning about the base concepts behind AI and machine learning. In addition, I am intrigued by the linguistics courses and its applications in AI.
